## Day by day

*Days in this plan start around 09:30 and end by 22:00, at a balanced pace (the defaults). For another rhythm, tell the concierge, e.g. "we wake up early, start at 07:00", "we stay out late" or "a more relaxed pace, please".*

### Day 1 – Thu 2027-06-03: airport
- **22:45 Arrive in Valencia** – Flight with Norwegian Air Sweden / Ryanair (see Getting there and back).

### Day 2 – Fri 2027-06-04: historical centre (walk 2.2 km)
- **10:00 Valencia Cathedral (Catedral de Santa María de València)** – Gothic cathedral whose origins trace back to a Roman temple, later a Moorish mosque. Climb the Miguelete tower for city views. Ticket **ticket €9**. Hours: Mon‑Sat 10:00‑18:30, Sun 14:00‑18:30. [source](https://catedraldevalencia.es/)
- **12:00 Almoina Archaeological Centre** – Underground museum exposing Roman baths, Moorish courtyard and Visigothic layers uncovered in 1985. Ticket **ticket €2**. Hours: Tue‑Sat 09:30‑19:00. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Valencia)
- **13:30 Lunch at Tasca Ángel** – Low‑budget tapas; try the grilled sardines. Budget tier: low. [source](https://www.facebook.com/Tasca-Angel-163047987042853/)
- **15:00 Almodí (Almodí Building)** – Restored 14th‑century granary hosting temporary art exhibitions; name means “bushel”. Ticket **ticket €2**. Hours: Mo‑Sa 09:30‑14:00, 15:00‑19:00. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Valencia)
- **16:30 Torres de Serranos** – One of Valencia’s medieval gates (built 1392); climb for panoramic views. Ticket **ticket €2**. Hours: Mo‑Sa 10:00‑18:00, Su 10:00‑15:00. [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/9281502)
- **20:30 Dinner at El Poblet Restaurante** – Michelin‑starred, seasonal tasting menu (mid‑budget). Budget tier: mid. [source](http://elpobletrestaurante.com/home)

### Day 3 – Sat 2027-06-05: City of Arts and Sciences (walk 3.6 km) – drizzle
- **10:00 City of Arts and Sciences** – Calatrava‑designed modern complex (opera house, museum, aquarium) on former Turia riverbed. Ticket **ticket €46.4**. Hours: Mon‑Fri 09:00‑20:00, Sat 10:00‑20:00. [source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/City_of_Arts_and_Sciences)
- **12:30 Príncipe Felipe Science Museum** – Whale‑shaped building with interactive science exhibits. Ticket **ticket €9.4**. Hours: Sat 10:00‑20:00 (summer 10:00‑21:00). [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/14693200)
- **14:30 Lunch at Alquería del Pou** – Mid‑budget; order the traditional Valencian paella. Budget tier: mid. [source](http://alqueriadelpou.com/)
- **16:30 Oceanogràfic** – Europe’s largest oceanarium, featuring dolphin shows and a shark tunnel. Ticket **ticket €41.8**. Hours: 10:00‑21:00. [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/23433776)
- **19:30 Dinner at Portland Ale House** – American‑style bar; enjoy a burger and a local craft beer. Budget tier: mid. [source](https://www.facebook.com/pages/Portland-Ale-House/35965599857?sk=wall)

### Day 4 – Sun 2027-06-06: Silk Exchange district (walk 2.0 km) – overcast
- **10:00 Silk Exchange (Llotja de la Seda)** – Gothic UNESCO World Heritage hall (built 1482‑1533) that was the centre of Valencia’s medieval silk trade. Ticket **ticket €2**. Hours: Mo‑Sa 10:00‑19:00, Su 10:00‑14:00. [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/23377876)
- **11:45 Museum of Ceramics and Decorative Arts (González Martí)** – Rococo palace displaying historic Valencian ceramics, including pieces by Picasso. Ticket **ticket €3**. Hours: 10:00‑14:00, 16:00‑20:00. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Valencia)
- **13:15 Museum of Fine Arts (Museu de Belles Arts de València)** – 19th‑century neoclassical building with Spanish paintings from medieval to early‑20th century (free entry). Ticket **free entry**. Hours: Tu‑Su 10:00‑20:00. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Valencia)
- **14:30 Snack at Bodega La Rentaora** – Mid‑budget tapas bar; try a quick tapa before the flight. Budget tier: mid.
- **18:00 Depart from Valencia** – Flight with Lufthansa (see Getting there and back).

## Food to try
- **paella** – Rice dish from the Valencian Community, Spain. [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q212121)
- **gazpacho** – Cold soup from Spain and Portugal. [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q202677)
- **churro** – Fried‑dough pastry. [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q727605)
- **marzipan** – Confection of sugar or honey and almond meal. [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q106252)
- **chorizo** – Pork sausage typical of the Iberian Peninsula. [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q23374)
- **aioli** – Provençal garlic‑oil sauce. [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q283231)
